title: Terrace Garden
headline: Rooftop gardens and terrace planting.
intro: Bring planting, places to sit and an outdoor rhythm to your rooftop. Terrace gardens begin with the practical details: structure, waterproofing, drainage and access.
faq: Can any terrace become a garden?
Suitability depends on the structure, permitted loads, waterproofing and drainage. Arrange a site review and obtain structural advice before installation.

title: Vertical Garden
headline: Vertical planting systems and green walls.
intro: Vertical gardens bring planting into spaces where ground area is limited. ANZ plans and installs green walls with attention to support, irrigation and continuing access for care.
faq: What should I check before adding a green wall?
Discuss light, wall condition, access, drainage and irrigation. The planting and support system should suit the site and its maintenance arrangements.

title: Villa Landscaping
headline: Garden design and installation for villas.
intro: A villa garden should belong to its architecture and the people who use it. Connect planting, pathways and places to pause through a landscape designed around your home.
faq: Can the garden work with an existing home?
Share a site plan and photographs of the existing space. Retained planting, access, drainage and how you use the garden help define the scope.

title: Pergola and Fabrication
headline: Pergolas, roofing and outdoor structures.
intro: Pergolas and fabrication define outdoor rooms. Explore shade, structure and material choices that complement your building, terrace or garden.
faq: Which pergola materials are available?

The existing ANZ service range includes glass, wood, polycarbonate, retractable roofing, shingle roofs and Mangalore tile gazebos. Confirm current availability and structural requirements for your site.

title: Luxury Landscapes
headline: Planting and landscape finishes.
intro: A considered landscape is shaped by proportion, planting and the way a space is lived in. ANZ brings garden design and execution together for bespoke outdoor environments.
faq: Where does a custom landscape begin?
Begin with the architecture, site conditions and your intended use. A detailed brief helps establish priorities and a suitable scope before materials are selected.

title: Swimming Pools
headline: Pool planning and surrounding landscape.
intro: Swimming pools are part of a larger outdoor setting. Discuss the pool, its surroundings and the practical systems that need to be coordinated before work begins.
faq: What pool work can ANZ undertake?
Share whether you need a new pool, an upgrade or surrounding landscaping. Confirm design, engineering, construction and equipment responsibilities in the written project scope.

title: Water Fountain and Ponds
headline: Fountains, ponds and water features.
intro: Fountains and ponds add a focal point to outdoor spaces. Their placement, water systems and care requirements deserve the same attention as the planting around them.
faq: What needs to be planned for a water feature?
Discuss filtration, circulation, power, cleaning access and safety. These requirements depend on the feature and should be agreed before installation.

title: Commercial Landscaping
headline: Landscape design for commercial sites.
intro: From building frontages to shared outdoor grounds, commercial landscapes must balance identity, everyday use and ongoing upkeep. ANZ brings planting and landscape execution into one coordinated scope.
faq: Can work be planned around an occupied site?
Share access restrictions, working-hour requirements and stakeholder approvals. Discuss phasing and practical constraints as part of the site assessment.

title: Landscape Irrigation
headline: Watering systems for lawns and planting.
intro: Irrigation should respond to the landscape it serves. Plan water delivery around planting zones, site conditions and practical access for inspection and maintenance.
faq: Can irrigation be added to an existing garden?
An assessment should check available water supply, planting needs, existing lines and access. Discuss repair or new installation after reviewing the site.

title: Softscape
headline: Lawns, planting and garden beds.
intro: Softscape brings together lawns, plants and the changing textures of a garden. ANZ selects and installs planting to suit the light, soil and use of the space.
faq: How are plants selected?
Light, soil, water availability, growth habit and maintenance needs guide the selection. Confirm species and availability when the planting schedule is prepared.

title: Hardscape
headline: Paving, paths and landscape structures.
intro: Paths, paved areas and landscape edges give a garden its shape. Coordinate materials, levels and drainage with the planting and everyday movement through the site.
faq: What should inform a paving choice?
Consider drainage, slip resistance, heat, access and maintenance as well as appearance. The right material depends on where and how the surface will be used.

title: Moss Wall
headline: Moss wall installations for interiors.
intro: Moss wall installations bring a distinctive material quality to interiors. Explore the visual treatment, product type and care requirements for your space.
faq: Is the moss living or preserved?
Confirm the actual product before specifying light, water or care requirements. Living and preserved systems have different needs; ask ANZ to identify the proposed system in the quote.

title: Garden Maintenance
headline: Scheduled garden and plant maintenance.
intro: A garden continues to evolve after installation. ANZ provides garden maintenance, with care planned around the plants, site conditions and the work your space needs.
faq: How often will the team visit?
Visit frequency and included tasks should be agreed after assessing the site. Ask for a written maintenance scope, including any exclusions or replacement arrangements.

title: Office Plant Rental
headline: Office plant rental and maintenance.
intro: Office plant rental, thoughtfully placed and cared for. ANZ helps select, deliver and install plants suited to your workplace, with ongoing maintenance arranged around the space.
faq: What is included in office plant rental?
ANZ’s existing service describes plant selection, installation and ongoing maintenance. Confirm plant quantities, visit frequency, rental duration and replacement terms in your quote.

title: FRP Planters
headline: Planter sizes, finishes and placement.
intro: FRP planters provide a way to introduce planting to interior and exterior spaces. Explore forms and finishes alongside the practical needs of your planting scheme.
faq: Can FRP planters be used outdoors?
Confirm the proposed product’s suitability, finish and drainage arrangement. Ask for the currently available sizes and options rather than relying on a fixed catalogue.
